label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Cloud Work Application at exact World interface world_cloud_work. Installation proves only that the self-contained interface package is present. Project availability requires the real project EE policy to admit world_cloud_work. Task connection requires an authored exact world_cloud_work interface binding plus this artifact binding. Live means the interface life has produced current cloud_work.status evidence; installed, available, or connected alone never proves liveness. Send cloud_work.request artifacts whose operation is one exact catalog id and whose arguments satisfy that catalog. The interface emits separate cloud_work.progress, cloud_work.status, cloud_work.attempt, cloud_work.result, cloud_work.diff, cloud_work.apply_candidate, or cloud_work.failure artifacts. A create request carries its environment, branch, prompt, attempt count, and optional starting-diff artifact ref explicitly; the interface never reads ambient workspace state. cloud_work.apply_candidate always reports applied=false and effect_status=not_applied. Its candidate carries the immutable diff/ref and digest, source task and attempt evidence, explicit target root-slot/branch/base evidence, and the authored review handoff. It is not proof of application. Applying requires a separately bound run in the existing git_worktree worker environment, an authored checkpoint required_verified_artifacts review requirement using operator.approval through operator_approval, and only after that admitted mark a tool admitted by the receiving run's formed git_worktree surface may materialize and apply the exact reviewed diff against the target evidence. The Cloud Work interface has no filesystem or git authority and must never report apply success.
